html:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the top 10 free check-in spots in Da Nang, with famous destinations such as: Love Bridge, My Khe Beach, Hai Van Pass, Han River Swing Bridge… let’s refer to the article before having the opportunity to set foot in Da Nang.

The first destination when visiting Da Nang is My Khe Beach

One of the beautiful and poetic beaches, when coming here, visitors not only swim, soak in the cool water but also participate in games on the sea such as: Rowing, surfing, jet skiing, or experiencing parasailing by canoe on the sea, will bring visitors an exciting feeling, the most beautiful is traveling to My Khe beach every summer.

Da Nang Love Bridge

A destination chosen by many young people as a check-in point, or to take wedding photos on their big day at the Love Bridge, besides, the bridge is also a place that attracts tourists from all over to come here to relax, watch the scenery and breathe in the air from the sea, dispelling all the sadness and fatigue of the bustling city.

Hai Van Pass

A check-in point chosen by many young people, with hairpin bends that always challenge drivers, but for backpackers, they enjoy the bends to take pictures.

Especially on days with clear blue sky, from the top of the pass, visitors can admire the cool scenery and check in for themselves beautiful pictures, especially in the autumn weather when standing from the top of the pass to enjoy the cool breeze, there is nothing more interesting.

Han River Swing Bridge

The bridge has a unique design, when night falls the bridge is illuminated by sparkling lights creating an extremely romantic scene, the bridge rotates at 1am with a 90-degree angle creating 2 paths for ships to pass through, then from 2am to 4am the bridge will return to its original position, on weekends the bridge will rotate earlier around 11pm the bridge starts rotating and after 24 hours it will return to its original position.

Currently the Han River Swing Bridge is a destination chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to travel Da Nang, especially on weekends or holidays, tourists often gather here to sightsee and walk to see the city skyline at night.

Ban Co Tien Peak is located on the top of the mountain of Son Tra Peninsula, from the top of the mountain visitors can admire the beautiful natural scenery, although the road to the top of the mountain is difficult and tiring, but when reaching the top, the scenery seems to disappear.

Helio Night Market

A market with a diverse menu, from local products to Asian – European cuisine or Da Nang street food, all are available in the market, visitors will easily find and enjoy snacks at the market.

Son Tra Peninsula

A destination chosen by many visitors every time they have the opportunity to go on a tour Da Nang, this place has many stops and check-in points that tourists visit, especially couples also choose Blue Lake as a check-in point on their wedding day.

In addition, Son Tra Peninsula is also a beautiful coral diving experience, visitors can take a canoe to the sea and experience the feeling of diving to see coral, with sparkling and fascinating coral reefs.

Dragon Bridge

As the name suggests, the bridge is designed in the shape of a dragon stretching out to the sea, and spanning the poetic Han River, especially at 9 pm every Saturday and Sunday, the bridge will spray fire and water, bringing visitors a sense of excitement and capturing beautiful photos next to the dragon bridge spraying water, spraying fire…

Linh Ung Son Tra Pagoda

Da Nang currently has 3 pagodas with the same name, the pagoda with its own design has a 67-meter-high Linh Ung Buddha statue located majestically overlooking the sea, especially the Buddha statue located on the majestic Son Tra hill.

Da Nang Rooster Church

Located right on Tran Phu Street, the center of the city, the Rooster Church has its own design that not only exudes beauty but also exudes the unique beauty of Religion and Spirituality and is a check-in point chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to set foot in Da Nang.

So above are the top 10 free check-in spots in Da Nang, book your tickets today to come to Da Nang to visit, enjoy and take virtual photos at these sacred spots.
